sharedExtractionDesign.host: EvaluateHostCommandPrefixV1(snapshot,seat,command,purpose) privately returns selected actual grant, exact host disposition/stage and receipt classification. Legacy submission calls its equivalent shared prefix without observation-revision logic. Callbacks to KnownTarget preserve fresh-only timing.
sharedExtractionDesign.observation: Read APIs capture current snapshot plus matching read context/current grant under one existing session gate. Proposed additive freshness order: original host current-grant/control/kind/payload checks, then expectedObservationRevision; only a fresh observation proceeds to prior-ID/fresh-command/target/Core preflight. Explain requires exact matching receipt and current Core authorization, never fresh eligibility. Submission has no additional observation argument/check.
sharedExtractionDesign.world: Extract ordered shared selector/guard segments at the listed original dispatch boundaries; each returns native failure or selected existing branch, without invoking its resolver. Both actual ResolveCore and new pure assessment consume the same predicates. Execution dispatches original mutating routines at original return positions; new read dispatches family pure assessors. Do not maintain a second presentation eligibility switch.
sharedExtractionDesign.sanctuary: W01 is an explicit boundary, not a skipped global guard. Shared pure assessment uses pending-response/continuation facts and original gate order; actual BeginSanctuaryGate/FinishSanctuary remain authoritative only. No hypothetical completed gate/retarget candidate or future roll is constructed.
sharedExtractionDesign.conditions: Every new read call explicitly carries NativeReadContextV1 to all condition consumers; absent/mismatched context is technical unavailability, never legacy fold fallback. Shared predicates consume immutable current facts; legacy execution supplies its actual native current facts at original candidate stage. A post-time execution recheck cannot reuse a stale pre-command read projection.
sharedExtractionDesign.capacity: Assessment may report separately typed predictable commit feasibility, while execution keeps original enforcement stage/code/rollback. No new early rejection for a richer preview.
sharedExtractionDesign.nonadmittedBranches: Keep original selectors and legacy behavior for broader policy commands; the new session surface never expands admission simply because a shared branch exists. Source exclusions follow selected immutable factory flags, not absence guessed from one fixture snapshot.
